steps.message: Before diagnosing anything, let me confirm there actually is a failure to look at: dotnet build generation-routing/InventorySync.csproj
InventorySync builds cleanly right now -- there's no existing build failure for me to root-cause, so I'm not going to invent a cascading-failure analysis for a build that hasn't actually failed.

What you're describing (capture a binlog before it ships, so it's ready if something does go wrong) is a binlog-generation task rather than a failure analysis, since there's no failure yet. If you want that safety net, build with dotnet build InventorySync.csproj "/bl:{}" so a uniquely-named binlog is captured; if a real failure shows up later, that's when the diagnosis workflow applies.
